editorial.blurb: This beloved Pilsen spot serves authentic birria—slow-cooked lamb or goat from Jalisco—with tender meat, flavorful consomé, and fresh corn tortillas that keep locals coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early on weekends to avoid long waits, bring cash (it's cash-only), and order the goat birria for a more authentic experience; quesatacos aren't available weekends.
